installCommand: echo 'Sin instalación previa: Flutter se obtiene en el build'
buildCommand: if [ ! -d flutter ]; then git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git --depth 1 -b stable; fi && export PATH="$PATH:$PWD/flutter/bin" && flutter --version && flutter pub get && dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs && flutter build web --release --dart-define=API_BASE_URL=$API_BASE_URL
